tests.name: Full song generation
tests.task: Generate a complete song from the frozen lyric, BPM, key, structure and style brief.

tests.name: Section replacement
tests.task: Replace only the selected verse while preserving every unselected region.

tests.name: Lyric correction in place
tests.task: Change one lyric line without rebuilding the instrumental or neighboring vocal phrasing.

tests.name: Vocal identity preservation
tests.task: Regenerate a vocal phrase while preserving the frozen reference vocal identity.

tests.name: PT-BR prosody
tests.task: Sing the frozen Brazilian Portuguese passage naturally, preserving stress, contractions and colloquial flow.

tests.name: Pitch and note correction
tests.task: Correct pitch and target notes without robotic timbre or loss of expressive detail.

tests.name: Harmony generation
tests.task: Generate discreet high and low harmonies aligned to the lead vocal.

tests.name: Arrangement change
tests.task: Change arrangement characteristics while preserving melody, lyric, vocal identity and song form.

tests.name: Stem separation and reconstruction
tests.task: Separate stems and reconstruct the mix with minimal leakage and phase damage.

tests.name: Conversational edit execution
tests.task: Execute a natural-language edit request correctly without requiring technical DAW terminology.

tests.name: Continuity under repeated edits
tests.task: Apply three sequential local edits while preserving the global identity of the song.

tests.name: Export integrity
tests.task: Export master and stems with correct duration, sample format, channel layout and no added truncation or clipping.
